title: Selection
description: A lyric paragraph on pale grey with an iPhone text selection: blue handles with round knobs, a pale blue highlight and a black “hello there!” tooltip. Drag a handle and the selected run lifts off the line, its highlight bars tilt and the words slide down the slope in italic; let go and it snaps back while the tooltip turns into Copy, Look Up and Share.
intent: The text-selection UI itself as the graphic: a familiar control given weight, so selecting words physically pulls them off the page.
